pass.description: Which pass emitted this envelope (Manager runs in all four)

library_path.description: Filesystem path to the prompts/ directory in the product

has_embedded_in_product.description: Convenience flag: is this prompt accessible via embedded-in-product surface?

canon_drift_message.description: If canon_drift_detected, the build-output message describing the drift

surface_observations.description: What the Manager noticed about the product, e.g. "product has narrow outbound surface but deep state machine"

derivation_difficulties.description: Things that were hard to derive cleanly, e.g. "three intents had overlapping semantics; merged into one prompt"

tier_distribution_note.description: Qualitative comment on tier mix, e.g. "library leans NARRATIVE-heavy; consider whether SYNTHESIS could replace some"

recommendations_for_downstream.description: Specific notes for later agents, e.g. "agent 04 may want to invoke {product}.ui-pattern-for-form"
